svg.title: 3D surface plot: The Lorenz attractor
svg.desc: 3D surface plot titled “The Lorenz attractor”. x axis, from -17.34 to 17.08. y axis, from -23.04 to 22.51. z axis, from 7.36 to 43.4. Colors stand for values from 7.36 to 43.4. 1499 points, x from -17.34 to 17.08; z is lowest, 7.36, at x = -3.32, y = -6.47, and highest, 43.4, at x = -16.25, y = -9.3.
